'''Morelle''' is a town near the southernmost boundary claimed by [[Cairhien]], halfway from Cairhien to the [[River Iralell]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Morelle}} 

==Activities==
After returning to Cairien in 999NE, [[Rand al'Thor]] set the [[Aiel]] on a mission hunting highwaymen and brigands. Aiel ''[[Shae'en M'taal]]'' killed almost two hundred bandits near Morelle.{{ref/book|5|51}}
